CHECKPOINT / 250 m

You have control. Hold thrust to climb or brake your fall.

01 / TAKE CONTROL

Small burns. Big changes.

Click the flight scene, then hold Space or ↑ for thrust. Use ← and → for sideways control. On a phone, hold the buttons above.

02 / COME HOME

Slow before touchdown.

Land within the green pad at no more than 6 m/s downward and 5 m/s sideways. Thrust slows a falling rocket. Steer the opposite way to reduce sideways speed.

03 / TRY AGAIN

Learn one flight at a time.

Fuel is limited. Try landing practice first, or turn on flight assist to see the timing. Use P to pause and R to reset while the scene is focused.
